messages.subject: Error /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request
parts:
Hi,

I've just build my first shiny apps! Everything is working well with runApp, however I can't deploy them with deployApp()

I first tried with my own application and got the following error :

Preparing to deploy application...
Update application currently deployed at
http://abrel.shinyapps.io/shinyapp2? [Y/n] Y
DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application...
Waiting for task: 19457
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building 34 packages
  building: Building package stringr-0.6.2
  building: Building package xtable-1.7-1
  building: Building package labeling-0.2
  building: Building package png-0.1-7
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 19458 error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 19462 failed: Error building package: Error building png (0.1-7). Image build exited with non-zero status: 1


Then, I tried with the example application provided in the tutorial and got the following error :

 setwd('C:/Users/abrel/Desktop/shiny example')
> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request

My session details are below :

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)
Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United Kingdom.1252  LC_CTYPE=C                             
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United Kingdom.1252 LC_NUMERIC=C                           
[5] LC_TIME=English_United Kingdom.1252    

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] shiny_0.8.0   shinyapps_0.2

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] bitops_1.0-6   caTools_1.16   digest_0.6.4   httpuv_1.2.0   RCurl_1.95-4.1
[6] RJSONIO_1.0-3  tools_3.0.2    xtable_1.7-1  


Any idea regarding what I did wrong?


Many thanks for your help!

Alexandre

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error /v1/applications/ 400 - Bad Request
parts:
I think the problem here is that the name of your application (which defaults to the name of the directory), has a space in it, which is an invalid name. I would try renaming that folder to something without a space.

Also the png R package is not supported at the moment.

-Andy
